messages.content: I want to order a custom bronze sculpture of a horse. What material options are available?

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
Here are the material options you can choose from for a custom sculpture:

| Material | Typical Finish | Common Uses |
|----------|----------------|-------------|
| **Bronze** | Matte or polished, often patinated | Classic statues, outdoor monuments |
| **Marble** | Smooth, translucent | Fine art, indoor displays |
| **Terracotta** | Rough, earthy | Garden sculptures, rustic pieces |
| **Wood** | Varies (oak, pine, walnut, etc.) | Warm, natural look, indoor or outdoor |
| **Stone** | Rough or polished (granite, limestone) | Durable, timeless pieces |

If you’d like to proceed with ordering a bronze horse sculpture (or explore another material), just let me know the size and any other preferences!
message.reasoning: The user wants to order a custom bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "What material options are available?" The function sculpture_create_custom has material options: Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. So we can answer that. Also we can offer to place order. But they just asked what material options are available. So we respond with list.
